about:
ASM Auto Supply operates from Chicago's Clearing neighborhood, near Midway Airport. The company runs a storefront and warehouse serving the surrounding communities. No founding year or ownership details are disclosed.

The business stocks new and vintage OEM automotive parts, truck parts, industrial hoses, belts, cleaning supplies, and fluids. Its warehouse holds thousands of vintage components purchased from dealerships, alongside hundreds of unlisted items. Services include free local delivery to businesses, garages, and homes; nationwide shipping for hard-to-find parts; free rotor and drum grinding (for a limited period); and part identification assistance with special ordering for non-stock items.

Customers include local repair shops, fleet operators, industrial maintenance teams, and vintage vehicle restorers across Chicago zip codes such as Bedford Park, Bridgeview, Burbank, Cicero, Oak Lawn, and others. The company also ships nationwide to individuals and shops seeking obsolete OEM parts.

ASM Auto Supply positions itself as a lower-priced alternative to national chains like AutoZone and Advance Auto Parts, emphasizing neighborhood service, free delivery, and a deep inventory of out-of-production parts sourced directly from dealerships.
